tbesh_html:
1) to bind, be distressed, be in distress, be cramped, be narrow, be scant, be in straits, make narrow, cause distress, beseige
1a) (Qal) to suffer distress

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to press (intransitive), i.e. be narrow; figuratively, be in distress
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be distressed, be narrow, be straitened (in straits), be vexed.
